tasks.short: Maintain actual inventory and order needed supplies.

steps.what: Check actual supplies, condition and discrepancies against the inventory ledger
Enter actual stock observations and resolve discrepancies in the inventory ledger
Calculate stock differences and populate proposed order references from verified inventory
inputs: existing authorized stock targets and supplier item references maintained by stores
outputs: proposed order with quantities and supplier references

steps.what: Decide supply needs and authorize the complete proposed order for its actual supplier
inputs: proposed order with quantities and supplier references
outputs: checked final order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the exact checked order to the selected supplier
inputs: checked final order and supplier destination

tasks.design: Use the inventory ledger's verified quantities and stores-maintained references to fill a proposed procurement order deterministically. Keep physical checks, initial stock entry, need and authorization decisions and the actual supplier send with the responsible worker; this does not control explosives handling or release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual quantity arithmetic and copying supplier references can follow an already reconciled ledger.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock comparisons and order templates can perform only that explicit preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Actual discrepancy resolution, permitted supply needs and ordering authority remain human.
tasks.human_edge: The worker notices unusable stock despite an apparently sufficient quantity.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time preparing references and retain control of actual supply needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory arithmetic and reference-based order preparation can be deterministic after actual stock reconciliation.

assumptions: Shares35/20/15/29/1 are provisional scenario allocations, not measured. The worker actually performs the manual calculations/reference copying and has ordering authority; otherwise map the real authorized reviewer and exclude their labour.

OPS_SYSTEM means the inventory ledger, not a blast control system. Stores already maintains stock targets and item references; capture and reconciliation remain s1/s2. No automatic replenishment or physical issue is proposed, and existing automatic calculations receive no credit.
unknowns: Are stock arithmetic and order references already populated?
research_questions: Time actual ledger entry, reconciliation and order preparation separately.

already_counted.description: Counts, discrepancy reconciliation and order checking remain in the baseline.

incremental.description: Maintain stock-reference mappings and test proposed order output.

All physical checks35, stock entry20, order decision29 and send1 remain.

tasks.short: Create and lay out drill and blast pattern designs.

steps.what: Verify survey information and actual site constraints for the pattern design
inputs: survey records produced by the survey team
actual site observations made by the blaster

steps.what: Create the actual drill and blast pattern using professional engineering judgement
outputs: worker-selected pattern geometry and design annotations

steps.what: Lay out chosen drawing layers and repeat existing nonengineering sheet annotations
inputs: worker-selected pattern geometry and design annotations

steps.what: Check design meaning, geometry and drawing scale and save the internal drawing
outputs: checked internal drill and blast design

tasks.design: Configure the CAD drawing application's existing sheet and layer presets to reduce repeated nonengineering layout work. The blaster creates and checks the actual design; no model chooses blasting parameters, no control action is issued, and the ordinary internal save remains within fully retained s4.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compatible drawing layers and repeated sheet annotations may be arranged manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD sheet presets can reuse those presentation settings without designing a blast.
tasks.still_hard: Site-specific design and interpretation of constraints remain fully retained.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a geometrically tidy drawing is unsuitable for the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Reuse drawing presentation while protecting engineering design time.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD sheet and layer presets can reduce repeated presentation work without making engineering decisions.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing CAD drawing application. Shares25/50/15/10 are provisional, not measured. Only3 points of s3 repeated annotations/layout are removed; geometry selection and placement checks remain.

This is design creation, not authorization to execute it. No execution approval or downstream send is silently automated. Survey work is an existing upstream input, not newly free capture; the blaster's source verification is s1.
unknowns: Do existing drawing layers and sheet standards match current CAD files?
research_questions: Observe repeated sheet setup separately from actual pattern engineering.

already_counted.description: Complete drawing check and ordinary internal save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain and verify CAD sheet presets against actual output.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 layout points less0.5 preset upkeep. Low: incompatible legacy layers force manual arrangement and geometry checking, leaving only0.8 points of repeated sheet-title setup removable, less0.5 upkeep. Actual engineering50 and verification25 remain throughout.

steps.what: Observe actual formations and capture their location, features and uncertainty during work
Write formation descriptions and enter actual observation references in the geological record
outputs: written geological description with observation references

steps.what: Check descriptions against observations, retain uncertainty and save the ordinary internal geological record
inputs: written geological description with observation references

tasks.design: Use a native document template with repeated project headings and observation-reference fields to support the actual geological record. Keep fresh field capture and the formation description with the worker, and retain checking and the ordinary internal save without an approval gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated headings and document arrangement distract from describing actual formations.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed geological observation template can remove only repeated formatting and stable headings.
tasks.still_hard: Actual observations, interpretation and explicit uncertainty cannot be supplied by the template.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an observed feature from an uncertain geological explanation.
tasks.altitude: Make actual formation records easier to trace without inferring geology.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can reuse stable headings while fresh geological observations and descriptions remain human work.

assumptions: Shares55/30/15 are provisional, not measured. s1 explicitly counts fresh observation capture. s2 removes3 points of repeated document formatting/headings, not geology interpretation or copying unverified observations.
The supplied oil/gas billing digest is not evidence for blast geology. No free transcription, image interpretation, generated geological claims or new reporting obligation is assumed.
unknowns: Are repeated geological record headings already templated?
research_questions: Compare actual observation writing with repeated formatting in completed records.

incremental.description: Keep the observation document template current.

tasks.short: Signal crane operators during actual equipment movement.

steps.what: Observe the actual movement area and establish readiness with the crane operator
outputs: current shared readiness and movement understanding

steps.what: Signal crane operators and monitor actual equipment movement and changing conditions
inputs: current shared readiness and movement understanding
outputs: actual human signals and monitored equipment movement

tasks.design: Keep the real-time readiness assessment and actual crane signals with the worker. A static lift-plan view or document template cannot observe changing conditions or perform these human signals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Signals depend on actual movement and current surroundings.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change performs these defined live actions.
tasks.still_hard: Continuous perception and direct coordination remain necessary.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a changing condition that makes the planned movement unsuitable.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a static plan view does not carry out live crane signalling or observe actual changing surroundings.

assumptions: Provisional shares60/40 are not measured. Record/report/send boundaries inspected: this task scenario assigns live signalling, not a permit entry or movement-log write. Any actual assigned log or permit action must be split and assessed against native forms before using this zero; it is not folded into signalling.
No robotic signalling, crane control, automatic movement authorization or newly invented admin baseline is proposed. The crane operator's own work is not counted as focal labour.
unknowns: Does this worker actually own a separate movement-log or permit entry?
research_questions: Observe the task boundary and identify any actual written entry separately.

incremental.description: No software change is proposed; no incremental maintenance is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain readiness60 and actual signalling40. A document view or native log form does not perform either action. Any actual owned written entry needs its own assessment before applying this zero.
